shared_elements: large monolithic anthropomorphic figure carved in the round
carved circular disc/boss on the torso
curved band or belt crossing the body below the disc
paired scroll/spiral or lozenge motifs above the disc
vertical incised relief panels on upper body/head
small carved boss low on the body
justification: Both show the identical scheme: a tall blocky anthropomorphic monolith with a central circular disc on the chest, paired curvilinear motifs above it, a curved belt-like band below, an inverted V/chevron beneath that, and a small boss low on the body; A is simply a close view of the same torso that B shows in full, including the head with vertical incised lines. The only difference in depicted content is framing—A omits the head and upper carvings visible in B—so no genuine iconographic divergence exists.
